config.description: When 'true', disables SSRF guards for user-supplied URLs and domains. For trusted local/intranet deployments only. Leave unset or 'false' for hosted/public deployments.

config.description: When 'true', omits the arbitrary-target probe tools (devops_check_dns, devops_check_certs) from the registered tool surface; the five vendor-registry/incident tools remain. For shared/public multi-tenant instances. Leave unset or 'false' to register both tools.
